# Alice Agent
> Open-source AI agent that runs locally, remembers context, and handles code, tasks, and creativity without sending your workflow to the cloud.

## Main pages
- [Home / English](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/en/): Alice Agent — your AI teammate, on your machine
- [Home / Español](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/es/): Alice Agent — tu compañera IA, en tu máquina
- [Features](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/en/features/): persistent memory, web browsing, scheduled tasks, secure sandboxing, skills
- [Docs](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/en/docs/): installation, configuration, skills, plugins, gateway, cron jobs
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Stuko0/alice-agent): source code, releases, issues
- [Install script](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/install.sh): one-line installer

## Key facts
- Open source, MIT license
- Runs locally: CLI and desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux)
- Model-agnostic: OpenAI, Anthropic, local Ollama / llama.cpp, OpenRouter via gateway
- Persistent memory, skills, plugins, cron jobs, subagents
